knimeNode.name: Population Migration
knimeNode.shortDescription: Exchanges strong candidates between populations in one combined table.

fullDescription.intro: Groups rows automatically by their IdeaFlow population identity and migrates the strongest feasible candidates using ring, reproducible-random, or all-to-all routing. Incoming candidates can replace the weakest destination candidates or be added. No generation counter is used: migration happens whenever this node executes.

ports.inPort: At least two population IDs per run, normally produced by Concatenate.
ports.outPort: One combined table ready for the shared loop end or population filters.
